evidence_requirements.statement: Every autonomous Codex execution entry point performs a deterministic preflight and proceeds only for SUPPORTED; UNKNOWN is BLOCKED.
Only observed managed ChatGPT/Codex entitlement is SUPPORTED; API-key, unknown, unsupported-provider, ambiguous, missing, or malformed observations are BLOCKED.
BLOCKED preflight prevents autonomous execution and performs no auth, provider, credit, or fallback continuation.
BLOCKED eligibility is included in existing doctor, public status, and explain projections with actionable remediation.
The preflight has no API-key input, persistence, or pass-through and requires no user email or persisted sensitive account detail.
Forbidden credit purchase/nudge, reset-credit consumption, identity rotation, and secondary-provider operations are never invoked, including failures.
Documented account, plan, and rate-limit observations are consumed conservatively; partial, contradictory, malformed, or missing observations are BLOCKED.
Limit exhaustion yields resumable BLOCKED state without bypass action and resumes after entitlement is restored.
Non-autonomous status, explain, and audit governance remains usable while autonomous execution is BLOCKED.
Eligibility decision state contains no email, account identifier, credential, or other sensitive persisted field.
Eligibility extends RuntimeProfile and capability/authorization readiness semantics without a parallel authority.
Authoritative runtime documentation states exactly what local Codex observations can and cannot prove about billing and allowance boundaries.

non_goals: Do not add OpenAI API-key or provider authentication.
Do not call billing, credit-purchase, nudge, reset, identity-rotation, or fallback-provider operations.
Do not add a second runtime, scheduler, public reporting mechanism, or account API integration.
Do not change WorkUnit scheduler internals, KEELBench, or unrelated behavior.
Do not merge, push, or close a PR without separate authorization.
objective: Add fail-closed ZERO_INCREMENTAL_COST Codex runtime preflight

requirements.statement: Implement a deterministic fail-closed ZERO_INCREMENTAL_COST preflight in RuntimeProfile/capability/authorization integration and autonomous Codex entry points, satisfying AC-01, AC-02, AC-03, AC-07, AC-08, and AC-11.
Surface blocked eligibility through existing doctor/status/explain and document proven versus unprovable billing boundaries, satisfying AC-04, AC-09, and AC-12.
Prove forbidden cost/auth continuation paths are absent and non-sensitive, satisfying AC-05, AC-06, and AC-10.

consequences: Changes authorization semantics for autonomous Codex execution and must fail closed under opaque or changing runtime evidence.
A false allow could create an incremental AI charge or bypass a limit; a false block must preserve resumable governance.
risk.review: Independent review of preflight classification, forbidden-operation non-invocation, authorization integration, and proof-limit documentation is required.

units.title: Implement runtime eligibility preflight and RuntimeProfile integration
